title: PACO VL/VLS vertical inline centrifugal pump — insufficient flow (OEM-specific candidate)
applicability: Only PACO VL and VLS vertical inline centrifugal pump families covered by the cited Grundfos/PACO manual
Exact catalog/model number, serial number, impeller configuration, rated duty and fluid must be checked against the unit nameplate and supplied manual
This candidate is not a universal centrifugal-pump fault matrix and is not yet eligible for live diagnostic ranking
mechanism: The cited PACO VL/VLS troubleshooting table associates insufficient flow with multiple possible conditions across priming and suction availability, suction restrictions or air ingress, speed and rotation, system head and fluid properties, parallel-pump suitability, impeller condition, wear-ring clearance and internal leakage. These are competing possibilities, not a single root cause.
symptoms: Measured or reported flow rate is below the expected duty for a PACO VL/VLS pump
Pump may continue to run while delivered flow is insufficient
requiredContext: Confirm the exact PACO VL or VLS product code, model/catalog number and serial number
Record the specified duty point, pump curve revision, impeller configuration and rated speed
Record actual operating speed, driver/rotation configuration and whether pumps operate in parallel
Record fluid identity, temperature, density/viscosity if known, and suction source level
Record suction/discharge tap locations, units, valve lineup and concurrent flow readings

hypotheses.cause: Incomplete priming, insufficient available suction head, air pockets/ingress or inadequate submergence
supportingEvidence: Documented loss of prime or incomplete priming record
Concurrent suction/source observations differ from the documented normal baseline
Air ingress or gas entrainment is independently evidenced
contradictingEvidence: Priming, suction source level and suction-line integrity are independently verified against the applicable installation conditions

hypotheses.cause: Suction valve, strainer or foot-valve restriction
supportingEvidence: Installed differential-pressure indication across a strainer changes against a comparable baseline
Valve-position and suction-pressure records indicate a changed suction path
Inspection record identifies obstruction or undersized/stuck foot valve
contradictingEvidence: Suction path and valve lineup are confirmed unobstructed by suitable evidence
confounders: Valve feedback may not prove physical valve position
No differential-pressure threshold is supplied by the cited manual

hypotheses.cause: Drive speed/rotation or installation total-head mismatch
supportingEvidence: Actual speed differs from the exact rated operating condition
Rotation/impeller installation record conflicts with the specified configuration
Measured duty point differs from the applicable pump/system curve
contradictingEvidence: Actual speed, rotation, impeller configuration and system duty are independently verified against the exact unit documentation
confounders: VFD command is not equivalent to measured shaft speed
System resistance and parallel-pump interaction can shift the operating point

hypotheses.cause: Impeller blockage/damage, wear-ring wear or internal leakage
supportingEvidence: Performance decline persists after external suction, speed and system conditions are verified
Approved inspection documents impeller obstruction/damage, wear or internal gasket leakage
contradictingEvidence: A verified external condition or instrument issue fully explains the low-flow indication
confounders: Pump configuration, fluid properties and inspection scope
No universal wear-clearance limit is supplied in this case

measurements.name: Flow rate
measurements.location: Installed flowmeter tag and pipe location
measurements.operatingCondition: Concurrent stable operating point; record speed, fluid and valve lineup

measurements.name: Suction pressure
measurements.unit: as installed; identify gauge or absolute
measurements.location: Exact suction tap relative to pump datum
measurements.operatingCondition: Concurrent with flow and discharge pressure at stable duty

measurements.name: Discharge pressure
measurements.unit: as installed; identify gauge or absolute
measurements.location: Exact discharge tap and downstream system location
measurements.operatingCondition: Concurrent with suction pressure and flow

measurements.name: Actual pump speed
measurements.location: Drive feedback or independent speed measurement; state which
measurements.operatingCondition: Record command, feedback and load state separately

measurements.name: Source liquid level
measurements.operatingCondition: Concurrent with suction and flow measurements

tests.name: Compare concurrent flow, suction/discharge pressure and actual speed with the exact PACO duty documentation
prerequisites: Use existing installed instruments and approved read-only records
Confirm exact model, instrument units, tap locations and timestamp alignment
Do not change valve positions or drive settings as an experiment
expectedOutcomes: A coherent suction-side deviation redirects review toward suction availability/restriction but does not prove a specific blockage
A verified actual-speed or rotation mismatch redirects review toward drive/configuration applicability
A duty point inconsistent with the exact pump and system curves requires configuration and system review before internal-fault ranking
interpretationLimits: No universal numeric pressure or flow thresholds are supplied by the cited manual
A command frequency is not proof of actual shaft speed
One pressure reading without location, unit and concurrent flow is incomplete

tests.name: Review installed source-level and valve-position indications
prerequisites: Use installed indicators and approved records from a safe location
Treat feedback as indication until physical position is independently verified
expectedOutcomes: A changed source level or suction-line status supports further review of suction availability
A changed valve indication supports review of the suction path but does not prove physical valve position
No recorded change leaves the relevant hypotheses unresolved
interpretationLimits: No manipulation of valves is prescribed by this case
No generic minimum submergence or suction-pressure value is supplied

tests.name: Plan internal inspection only under the exact approved shutdown and service procedure
prerequisites: Exact model-specific manual and approved work order
Qualified personnel and site energy-control process
Documented inspection scope and post-inspection verification
expectedOutcomes: Documented obstruction or damage supports the inspected hypothesis within the inspected scope
No visible defect does not exclude hidden wear, internal leakage or intermittent process conditions
interpretationLimits: This case is not an instruction to dismantle equipment
Use the supplied OEM manual and site procedure; do not infer clearances or repair limits

limits: The source is specific to PACO VL/VLS vertical inline centrifugal pumps; do not generalize the cause matrix to unrelated pump families
The cited manual lists possible causes but does not supply universal numeric pressure, flow, speed or wear thresholds
Exact pump curve, impeller, speed, fluid, system resistance and instrument locations govern interpretation
No probability, root cause or field validation is claimed
stopConditions: Any operating condition outside the exact OEM/site operating envelope
Severe abnormal noise/vibration, rapid temperature rise, leakage or an active stop alarm
Uncertain isolation or need for internal inspection without approved work controls
verification: Confirm exact PACO VL/VLS model and serial applicability before using this candidate
Record concurrent post-correction flow, suction/discharge pressure and actual speed at comparable conditions
Keep the case unresolved until the exact pump duty and corrective outcome are documented
